correctness.rationale: The rank-three invariant follows exactly from the rank-zero adjacency/equality diagrams and three successive sets of one-vertex extension types, accounting for repeated pebbles. Disjoint union with a fresh isolate preserves three-round equivalence, and complement converts this to universal-vertex addition; hence 2-letter transition closure gives an all-orders bound. The standalone certificate recomputes 357 pairwise distinct states, all 714 transitions, an independent Hintikka recursion and 8191 creation words; BFS shortest-word minimality certifies the two sharp 17-vertex classes. Finite enumeration is coupled to a genuine infinite closure proof.

value.rationale: The statement calculates a natural complete finite-model-theoretic invariant of the standard threshold-graph family: all 357 rank-three classes, each minimal-order count, and the sharp representative kernel 17. The certified all-orders saturation is a useful finite canonical test set for rank-three sentences, not an arbitrary finite sample; the two sharp extremal words and transition monoid give reproducible exact structural data. It is not subsumed by merely knowing that finite-rank FO has finite index.
